title: WS-2: Resolve active MAP output ownership collisions
description: Child of TASK-309, gated on TASK-310. On Smalls authority, reconcile the nine active output-path collisions identified in the approved recovery evidence. Preserve history, use only sanctioned lifecycle verbs, retire or re-scope superseded work with reasons, and leave exactly one active owner per output. Do not add new lifecycle verbs or bypass policy gates.
acceptance_criteria: All nine baseline active collision groups are listed with authoritative before state, decision, actor, sanctioned command, and after state.
Every active output path has exactly one nonterminal owner; historical task and review evidence remains intact.
TASK-297, TASK-304, and TASK-308 remain gated unless their exact pre-existing approval requirements are independently satisfied.
Collision validators and mirror validation pass, with independent review by an agent other than the owner.
